The 30 September strategic digest says Mateo submitted ticket #8841 for Door 14 at Newark. Drivers on the second shift couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. The digest also says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

I'd check that number before you use it. In #strategic-pod on 1 July you wrote that you closed #8841 with support. That was for the Detention Summary CSV export and the kiosk tablet browser cache issue, which is a different problem. So the digest may have the wrong number, or the ticket number was reused. I can't see the ticket system, so I can't tell which.

The only other Vantorre ticket I can see is INC-4821. That one is the Hartford status-page access issue from 3 August, not Newark Door 14.

I'd confirm the number in the support queue, or with Mateo, before you send the engineering follow-up.
